name: 28139 · Rutherfordton, NC
findings: ZIP 28139 (Rutherfordton) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28139 (Rutherfordton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28139 (Rutherfordton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.
